THE PORTRAIT EDIT
ISSUE 01 / OCTOBER 2026
ROMANTIC GEOMETRY
041
54 / Lilac Rosette
Full-length look on a seamless light gray backdrop: long
straight black hair, a fitted lilac ribbed mini dress with rosette
flowers and tied ribbons at the neckline and a ruffled
flower-wave hem, worn with sheer white slouch socks and
chunky black foldover boots.
55 / Plaid Collar
A windswept studio portrait: auburn hair tied with a red
velvet ribbon, pale blue eyes and rosy cheeks, a blue plaid ruffled
Peter Pan collar with burgundy piping over a cropped white
cable-knit cardigan, a matching high-waist knit skirt and a
pearl-beaded bag.
